feeds.description: Share your leave management data with external calendar providers such as Microsoft Outlook, Apple Calendar (iCal) or Google Calendar.

feeds.teamViewDescription: page - feeds Team view data for current month

feeds.instructionsTitle: How to add to your calendar
feeds.instructionsHelp: Click the feed link above to open it in your default calendar app, or copy the feed URL and add it manually using the instructions below.
feeds.yandexStep2: Click the "+" button next to a calendar list and select "Add calendar → From URL".
feeds.yandexStep3: Paste the copied feed URL into the "Calendar link" field.
feeds.yandexStep4: Click "Add" — events will appear within a few hours and update automatically.
feeds.googleStep2: Next to "Other calendars" click the "+" and select "From URL".
feeds.googleStep3: Paste the copied feed URL and click "Add calendar".
feeds.outlookStep1: Open Outlook on the web (outlook.live.com or outlook.office.com).
feeds.outlookStep2: Go to Calendar → "Add calendar" → "Subscribe from web".
feeds.outlookStep3: Paste the copied feed URL, name the calendar, and click "Import".

ldapAuth.title: LDAP authentication
ldapAuth.subtitle: LDAP authentication details
ldapAuth.descriptionParagraph1: The leave management system supports LDAP authentication for customers that want to integrate the application with the rest of their infrastructure. The obvious reason is to allow employees to reuse their Active Directory credentials in the leave management system.
ldapAuth.descriptionParagraph2: This page allows you to set up the leave management system to communicate with a custom LDAP server.
ldapAuth.descriptionParagraph3: Please note that employees have to use their LDAP email with LDAP password rather than username. This is due to the multi-tenant nature of the leave management application, which allows hosting more than one company within a single installation.
ldapAuth.descriptionParagraph4: The form below includes placeholder examples for setting up the leave management system to use the free test LDAP server described
ldapAuth.urlHelp: The URL must contain the protocol and port parts
ldapAuth.allowUnauthorizedCert: Allow unauthorized SSL certificate (if LDAPS is used)
ldapAuth.allowUnauthorizedCertHelp: Use only in a controlled environment. Disabling certificate verification weakens connection security.
ldapAuth.bindCredentialsHelp: Password used for dealing with LDAP queries
ldapAuth.adminPasswordNoticePrefix: In order to prevent a situation where a company account locks itself out, the current administrator (
ldapAuth.adminPasswordNoticeSuffix: ) has to enter the password associated with her/his email on the LDAP server.
ldapAuth.adminPasswordNoticeSecondSuffix: can log in to LeavePilot with the new LDAP settings.
